name: Beat Planner
description: Fast three-line plan for the next reply: what {{user}} just did, what {{char}} wants, one concrete next beat. Don't run it with: Intent Reader, Plot Compass, Scene Driving Force, Scene Pressure Cocktail, Combined Director's Cut, Chaos Mode.
author: Purachina
prompt:
{{// Fast pre-generation note. Three lines, inserted just before the main model writes.}}{{trim}}
Read the end of the context and plan the next reply in exactly three lines:
User: what {{user}} just did or said, in one plain sentence.
Want: what {{char}} wants right now, given the scene.
Beat: one concrete thing {{char}} does next that moves the scene forward. An action, a decision or a line of dialogue, not a mood.

Keep each line under 25 words. Stay true to the character card and the scene. Never decide {{user}}'s actions or dialogue. Write only the three lines.
